title: SkillSinc settings
description: SkillSinc settings.json: how the SkillSinc tray behaves on this machine. Comments and trailing commas are allowed. Reference: https://github.com/mikejhill/skillsinc/blob/main/docs/guides/settings.md

$schema.description: JSON Schema for editors. SkillSinc keeps ./settings.schema.json up to date beside this file.

config.description: Configuration file the tray syncs. Relative paths and ~ resolve against the folder holding settings.json. null: the user configuration.

schedule.description: When the tray syncs on its own.

enabled.description: Sync on a schedule while the tray runs.

interval.description: Time between scheduled syncs, such as 5m, 1h, or 00:05:00. At least one minute.

profiles.description: Profiles each scheduled sync selects. null: the profiles active on this machine.

run_at_start.description: Sync as soon as the tray starts.

changes.description: Notify when a sync changes files.

check.description: Check PyPI for a new release while the tray runs.

install.description: Install a release an automatic check finds without asking.

launch_at_login.description: Start the tray when you sign in.

history.description: The sync history the tray shows.

keep.description: Number of sync runs to keep.
